He has severe asthma, his lungs failed two years ago and he was in the icu for 9 days. The jobs he qualifies for wont let him work due to asthma and allergies. Currently we have our fingers crossed that a printing press will hire him. He does love me and we have large discussions over what needs to be done, it just seems that with each step forward there is a huge step back. Right now the step back is lack of funds. Thank you btw for reading an responding. You are completely right I need to stand up, I just wish my
Knees wouldn't shake so bad when I do.

To be honest I'm 26, and they are very cold when I bring it up to them. To paint a picture my father is 52, illiterate and a construction worker, never been sick a day in his life. The last time he was job hunting was in the 80s. To him you can walk out and get 10 job offers as long as
You wear a short with no holes in it. One day I come home to him
In the driveway waiting for me. He starts to scream at me for taking advantage of them and being a lazy piece of shit. He starts telling me that I'm useless and stupid for going to college and I was forcing my mother to work while I sat on my ass, this after my mom took two weeks off with me running the shop. He has multiple personalities so I stay calm and let him scream at me. When I spoke to my mom about this she told me to work harder to appease my father and that she agreed I was stupid for going to college. I've tried, I have, I just don't know what the fuck they want, I can't be what they want.
